## Brand & Style

This design system serves deaf and hard-of-hearing students mastering academic curriculum and sign language simultaneously. The aesthetic balances gamified delight with profound academic respect, avoiding trivializing tropes (such as points, badges, or auditory-only chimes). Instead, motivation stems from visible progress, tactile feedback, and total visual clarity.

The visual style is **Tactile Neomorphic-Pop**: high-contrast, structured, and inherently physical. Large, chunky interactive surfaces respond with tangible press states, anchoring every interaction with physical certainty. Generous whitespace, unambiguous typography, and high-contrast boundaries ensure an interface free of cognitive clutter and visual fatigue.

### Core Principles
- **Visual-First Certainty**: Since audio cues are absent or secondary, all feedback is dual-encoded through distinct color shifts, motion, iconography, and text labels.
- **Physical Responsiveness**: Buttons and interactive tiles employ offset bottom borders that compress mechanically upon click or tap, mimicking real-world switches.
- **Respectful Gamification**: Progress is tracked through concept mastery pathways and comprehension completion rather than disposable XP or competitive point tallies.
- **Cognitive Ergonomics**: Restful pale backgrounds reduce screen glare, paired with charcoal typography calibrated well above accessibility thresholds.

## Colors

The palette relies on a sunny, low-fatigue backdrop paired with clean white foreground modules, punchy tactile actions, and high-contrast text.

### Color Roles & Accessibility Rules
- **Base Canvas (`#DDF4FF`)**: A soft, calming sky wash that eliminates the harsh glare of raw white screens during extended learning sessions.
- **Surface Layer (`#FFFFFF`)**: Pure white reserved for modular cards, dialogue containers, and interactive option tiles.
- **Primary Action (`#A5ED6E`)**: High-energy lime green used for positive progress meters and forward-moving primary buttons. Always paired with near-black (`#111111`) text or iconography to surpass WCAG AAA contrast standards. Its structural 3D base uses `#72B043`.
- **Secondary / Action Retry (`#FF7B54`)**: Warm coral-orange dedicated to "try again" states, revision alerts, and non-punitive corrections. Never used without an accompanying icon. Its structural 3D base uses `#CC5028`.
- **Accent & Decorative (`#1CB0F6`)**: Bright cyan-blue restricted strictly to non-text decorative badges, structural borders, active state rings, and visual highlights.
- **Readable Blue (`#0B6FB0`)**: Used exclusively whenever blue is applied to text, instructional links, or critical visual glyphs to guarantee WCAG AAA compliance against white surfaces.
- **Typography Neutrals**: Primary body and heading copy is set in Charcoal (`#3C3C3C`). Supporting metadata, secondary instructions, and captions use Slate (`#5A5A5A`). Washed-out or light gray text is strictly forbidden.
- **Structural Outlines (`#E5F2F8`)**: Soft perimeter borders framing white cards against the sky canvas to preserve crisp edge definition.

## Typography

Typography uses **Nunito Sans** uniformly across all tiers to provide rounded, approachable, and legible letterforms. The typeface’s open apertures and clean counters enhance reading speed and word recognition for visual learners.

### Typographic Rules
- **Minimum Body Size**: No instructional copy or interface content may scale below `16px`. Captions (`13px`) are restricted solely to secondary metadata, timestamps, and auxiliary assistive tags.
- **Weight Calibration**: Because rounded fonts can lose definition at thinner weights, `600` (SemiBold) is the operational baseline for standard reading text. Titled headings and interactive control triggers use `700` and `800` (Bold and ExtraBold).
- **Line Heights**: Generously spaced leading ensures clear optical separation between lines, preventing visual crowding for readers utilizing real-time visual tracking or closed captions.

## Layout & Spacing

This design system uses a strict **10px base unit system** (`0.625rem`). All paddings, gap measures, and layout rhythms are multiples of 5px or 10px to establish consistent visual cadence across every viewport.

### Layout Rhythm & Fluid Grid
- **Desktop (1024px and above)**: 12-column layout with a maximum container boundary of `1200px`. Section margins are set to `30px` (`1.875rem`) with gutters of `20px` (`1.25rem`). Multi-column split views prioritize side-by-side sign video viewports and accompanying exercise fields.
- **Tablet (768px – 1023px)**: 8-column layout with `20px` gutters and `20px` canvas margins. Instructional videos transition above interactive modules.
- **Mobile (Up to 767px)**: 4-column layout with `10px` (`0.625rem`) gutters and `20px` (`1.25rem`) outer margin. Touch controls snap to sticky bottom anchor bars for one-handed operation.
- **Spacing Token Map**:
  - `space-xs`: `5px` (`0.3125rem`) – micro-gaps between badge icons and companion copy.
  - `space-sm`: `10px` (`0.625rem`) – interior control padding and tight component clusters.
  - `space-md`: `20px` (`1.25rem`) – internal card padding, standard vertical flow gap.
  - `space-lg`: `30px` (`1.875rem`) – gaps separating distinct lesson cards and exercise stages.
  - `space-xl`: `40px` (`2.5rem`) – major structural section dividers.

## Elevation & Depth

Rather than relying on atmospheric, hazy drop shadows that degrade clarity, this design system creates depth through **Physical Solid Extrusions and Crisp Borders**.

### Depth Layers
- **Level 0 (Canvas Base)**: Flat sky blue background (`#DDF4FF`).
- **Level 1 (Surface Cards & Modals)**: Pure white surface (`#FFFFFF`) with a `2px` solid border in `#D4ECF7` and a flat vertical drop offset: `0px 4px 0px 0px rgba(28, 176, 246, 0.12)`. No blur is used; separation is clean, geometric, and distinct.
- **Level 2 (Tactile Interactive Components)**: Buttons and clickable tiles feature a solid `4px` bottom extrusion border. When depressed, the component physically translates downward along the Y-axis by `2px` to `3px`, collapsing the bottom lip to simulate real hardware keystrokes.
- **Focus & Selection**: Selected option cards replace the baseline border with a `3px` solid `#1CB0F6` outline coupled with a faint inner tint (`rgba(28, 176, 246, 0.06)`), ensuring unambiguous visual feedback without color-alone dependency.

## Shapes

The interface is defined by approachable, rounded forms. All structural content cards, primary push buttons, and input modules share a standardized **12px corner radius**.

### Shape Tokens & Radius Rules
- **Base Components (`12px`)**: Applied consistently to lesson cards, prompt surfaces, action buttons, camera/video viewports, and interactive choice blocks.
- **Pill Modules (`9999px`)**: Reserved for metadata chips, progress trackers, step badges, and status pills to distinguish them from pressable rectangular cards.
- **Micro Radii (`6px`)**: Applied to internal controls like slider thumbs, checkbox handles, and sub-tags within dense layouts.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Touch Target & Size**: Minimum height is `48px` (exceeding the standard `44px` target) with `12px` corner radii and horizontal padding of `20px`.
- **Primary Action (Proceed / Confirm)**: Fill `#A5ED6E`, text `#111111`, bottom border `4px solid #72B043`. On `:active` or `:pressed`, the element shifts `translateY(3px)` and the border compresses to `1px solid #72B043`.
- **Secondary / Retry**: Fill `#FF7B54`, text `#FFFFFF`, bottom border `4px solid #CC5028`. Paired with a bold undo/retry icon.
- **Neutral / Outline**: Fill `#FFFFFF`, text `#3C3C3C`, side and top border `2px solid #E5E5E5`, bottom border `4px solid #D0D0D0`.
- **Focus Ring**: A visible `3px` solid `#0B6FB0` offset ring appears on keyboard navigation for clear visual focus.

### Interactive Option Cards (Multiple Choice & Sign Matching)
- **Resting**: Fill `#FFFFFF`, `2px solid #E2EFF5`, bottom border `4px solid #D0E4ED`, radius `12px`, padding `20px`.
- **Active / Focused**: Border shifts to `2px solid #1CB0F6` with a bottom lip of `4px solid #0B6FB0`.
- **Correct State**: Fill `rgba(165, 237, 110, 0.15)`, border `2px solid #72B043`, bottom border `4px solid #72B043`, accompanied by a bold checkmark icon.
- **Incorrect State**: Fill `rgba(255, 123, 84, 0.12)`, border `2px solid #CC5028`, bottom border `4px solid #CC5028`, accompanied by a retry icon.

### Form Inputs & Text Fields
- Clean white background, `48px` minimum height, `12px` border radius, framed by a `2px solid #D0E4ED` border.
- Text color is `#3C3C3C` with placeholder text set in Slate `#5A5A5A`.
- Active focus displays a `2px solid #0B6FB0` border with a subtle `3px` focus glow ring.

### Checkboxes & Toggle Controls
- Custom square box (`24px × 24px`) with `6px` radius, `2px solid #5A5A5A`.
- When checked: Fill `#A5ED6E`, border `#72B043`, housing a heavy `#111111` check glyph. Avoid thin lines that might compromise visual verification.

### Status Chips & Progress Indicators
- **Linear Progress Bars**: Track container with `16px` height, radius `9999px`, background `#FFFFFF`, border `2px solid #D0E4ED`. The active fill is `#A5ED6E` with a bright glossy cap indicator for immediate reading.
- **Concept Badges**: Pill-shaped (`radius: 9999px`), padding `6px 14px`, text `#0B6FB0`, background `rgba(28, 176, 246, 0.12)`, accompanied by a bold category icon.

### Video & Sign Demonstration Canvas
- Framed in a pure white wrapper with a `12px` border radius and a `2px solid #D4ECF7` contour.
- Integrated video controls are high contrast, featuring closed captions rendered in `#FFFFFF` on a `#111111` solid backdrop at `16px` minimum font size.
- Video playback speeds include quick-toggle buttons (`0.5x`, `0.75x`, `1x`) designed as chunky tactile buttons for simple sign analysis.
